findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects in this bucket are stored unencrypted by default rather than encryption being the automatic state.

findings.issue_category: missing public access block / no ACL restriction
findings.description: No acl is set and no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is applied, leaving the bucket subject to default settings and potential public exposure with no explicit guardrail.
The bucket holds financial ledger export data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving sensitive data unencrypted at rest.
Versioning is not enabled for this sensitive ledger data bucket, allowing accidental or malicious overwrite/deletion without recovery (also relevant given force_destroy is set).
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket despite storing model artifacts, so data is unencrypted at rest by default.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, leaving operational runbook data (which may contain sensitive operational details) unencrypted at rest.

The acl is set to log-delivery-write, which grants the predefined LogDelivery group write and read-acp permissions; combined with no public access block, this could allow broader access to audit logs than intended if not carefully scoped.

The object is uploaded to a bucket lacking default encryption and no server_side_encryption is specified on the object itself, so the vendor roster file (potentially containing sensitive vendor data) is stored unencrypted.
force_destroy = true allows the bucket and all its contents to be permanently deleted without recovery, removing a safeguard against accidental or malicious data loss.
force_destroy = true permits irreversible deletion of financial ledger export data along with the bucket, increasing risk of data loss.

findings.issue_category: force_destroy enabled on audit log bucket
findings.description: force_destroy = true on the audit trail bucket allows deletion of audit logs, undermining the integrity and availability of security audit records.
